scope: Two forest idle beds, four outdoor horse-hoof contacts, three Pan goat/body-fall death takes, three stone-grind recovery takes; no mesh/action changes
acceptance_basis: User WP1 unit sound repair assignment; source archives verified, exact role/material matches, unchanged section3 mastering gates

collection_credit.creator: congusbongus
collection_credit.title: Horse gallop on different surfaces
collection_credit.license: CC BY 4.0 collection; used ground/grass members explicitly CC0 in credits.txt

astats.source: ffmpeg astats; checked against direct decoded samples

limiter_and_loop_correction.pipeline: recorded source highpass/trim/fades; bounded real-sample alimiter; EBU loudnorm; measured final gates

limiter.alignment: same-rate mono samples; alimiter latency compensation enabled
limiter.method: maximum aligned abs(dry)/abs(wet) ratio above active floor
limiter.ceiling: 0 dBFS sample peak before EBU true-peak loudness normalization
